notes: Posted 6 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (10): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Epic Duel, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Start Your Engines!, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer and Imperial Arrest Order; these count toward the 60. The strategy says 'at least you can start with IAO', so Imperial Arrest Order is the starting Effect (deployed free by Start Your Engines!).
Visage Of The Emperor (unique) is posted once in Starting and 'x 2' under Effects; kept as published (3 copies).

Two-sided generic cards dested the Dark pages: Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark) (posted 'Tattoine Podrace Arena'), Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark), Yavin 4: Docking Bay (Dark), Lift Tube (Dark).

Posted 'Executer ...' dested the Executor: sites; 'Vader, Dark Lord of the Sith' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader w Saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Mara Jade' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Vaders Saber' dested Vader's Lightsaber; 'Mara's Saber' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Omni Box/Its Worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Circle is Now Complete' dested The Circle Is Now Complete; 'This is Some Rescure' dested This Is Some Rescue!; 'Twilek Advisor' dested Twi'lek Advisor. Secret Plans, No Escape and Come Here You Big Coward are 2001 Effects, counted in the 60.
The match-up text mentions using 'Endor Celebration' to cancel Cloud City Celebration; the list has Endor Occupation (kept as posted).
The post thanks Justin Alfs for showing him the deck; it names no tournament.
